books.title: Miko Swallows a Tooth Fairy
books.hook: Miko’s wobbly tooth fell out in the night… and she SWALLOWED it!
books.short: A gloriously snotty tooth fairy adventure.
blurb: So Luna, a brand-new tooth fairy on her third night ever, has to pop in and find it. Down she goes — GULP! — straight into Miko’s tummy soup.
Can the Emergency Rescue Squad get her out? It’s going to take a feather, two umbrellas and the biggest, bogiest sneeze in the world.
A gloriously snotty tooth fairy adventure for anyone with a wobbly tooth.
